correctness.rationale: The criterion follows from the exact orthogonal innovation variance, an independently justified auxiliary square-summability lemma, martingale convergence and Kronecker’s lemma; the converse follows by fixed-index lower bounds. Residual computational tests are not infinite proofs.

value.rationale: A recent paper explicitly leaves open characterization of weights yielding a nondegenerate global linear-scale path-length limit. An iff criterion answers this mathematical gap for the full deterministic-weight model. The stretched-exponential regime exhibits two independent sharp fluctuation thresholds and a logarithmic critical boundary, revealing distinct local and global mechanisms rather than a routine special-case computation.
